notes: Needs ruling: the text has three routes and the rules do not settle how the «وقالا، جميعا» route (Ibn Abi Adi, Sa'id) and the «ح» branch (Mu'adh, then Qatada and Mutarrif) relate to one saying. Each route is written as the text writes it, with no tail.
«فذكر بمثل حديث همام» is a remark with no chain of its own, left out.
«حدثنا أبي» (Mu'adh's father) and «عن أبيه» (Mutarrif's father) are bare relations (rule 7); «ابن أبي عدي» contains «أبي» too, so the relation is the second occurrence.
